knobs.note: PRs (WAIT_CI or READY, approved on their head) one backstop fire hands to the keyed conductor run: the keys the last fire deferred first, then the harness's own repo, then the oldest. The rest are logged as deferred and the next fire takes them first (state/merge-conductor/backstop-carry). The run also starts a PR worker only while 15 s or more are left before its worker cap (MC_BACKSTOP_TIMEOUT_S minus 45 s), and hands the rest to the next fire the same way, so a fire never takes more than it can finish. 6 fits one 240-290 s window (14 keys died at 290 s on 2026-10-08). 0 is no cap. Row: lane.merge-conductor-backstop.mc_backstop_max_keys

timeout on the keyed conductor run, which must end before the next */5 fire. Each PR worker of that run is capped at this minus 45 s, never under 30 s (BH-4918), so a slow PR is killed alone before the timeout kills the whole run. A non-number falls back to 240. Row: lane.merge-conductor-backstop.mc_backstop_timeout_s
